name: Podio
verdict: Likely self-serve: register an API key and run the authorization-code flow against any Podio user's account, with no marketplace review known. Low confidence, recalled from memory, not verified; likely 1-3 days.
needGuide: Short one, but confirm the registration steps and token details in current docs first.
